notes.title: "Mutated Muter's Invasion" Gets a Major Refactoring!
A Tutorial Level Now Available!
notes.notes:
Confused over the gameplay mechanics and/or controls? No more worries! With the newly added tutorial level, you can say goodbye to the confusion and focus on beating the game. The tutorial level will not reveal [i]everything[/i] the game has to offer, though, as it is not meant to be a spoiler ːsteammockingː. However, it WILL walk you through the basics that you need to know.

Also, as a reminder, it is now the Summer Sale, so use your chance to get "Mutated Muter's Invasion" with a discount!

notes.title: Full Release Feature Update: Leaving Early Access
notes.notes:
Dear Un-Muters,

After a productive Early Access stage, "Mutated Muter's Invasion" has now been feature-updated to transition to full release! Players can now enjoy all the long-planned features.

During Early Access, many improvements and updates had been happening, of which not all were possible to cover in announcements. This includes both internal improvements to the code (e.g. to improve performance) and visible changes (e.g. balancing the gameplay more). "Mutated Muter's Invasion" had also got Steam Cloud saves and Steam Achievements.

Now here is a quick summary of what is up with this big update:
[list]
[*]More levels:
The set of levels is now as originally planned. That's right, there are now more levels!

[*]More secrets:
In the levels, there are now more places to hunt for that are not immediately obvious, from truly "secret" to more or less "secret". Such places can be quite rewarding to find and give you useful items, so have fun exploring!

[*]More mechanics:
They will not let you get bored! Look for them especially in the new levels!

[*]More power-up and item types:
For example, the "super crescendo"; some are in the secret places mentioned above.

[*]4 more Steam Achievements, totaling 35:
One of them is for finding a secret place that can be dangerous to discover.
[/list]

Of course, leaving Early Access does NOT mean the development will cease completely! The Community can still expect that feedback will be listened to and that improvements and updates will continue to happen.

notes.title: Steam Achievements Are Now Here!
notes.notes:
Dear Un-Muters,

Steam Achievements are finally implemented in "Mutated Muter's Invasion", so now playing the game is more rewarding than it was before! This update brings 31 achievements. Of course, the Community is still welcome to express achievement-related ideas, and will always be (even after Early Access)! This includes both ideas for other achievements that could potentially be added and feedback on the current ones.

You may have noticed that few achievements have expert-mode counterparts, while others that, as it may seem, could do the same, do not. For example, since the "Ain't Afraid of Any Saws" achievement does have an expert-mode counterpart, it might seem reasonable that the "That Crazy Jump" achievement do too. However, doing the "crazy jump" in the first quarter-note level is actually equally difficult in all of the difficulty modes, whereas passing the "annoying saws section" in the expert mode is an exceptional task. This is why the developer believes that choosing which gameplay-related achievements should have expert-mode counterparts should be done mindfully. At the same time, however, considering how difficult the game becomes in general in the expert mode, getting to promote your musical note rank in the expert mode ought to be rewarded; this is why these ("Quarter Note", "Half Note", and "Whole Note") DO have expert-mode counterparts. Now [b]here is the nice part[/b]: if you unlock an expert-mode achievement, you automatically win its regular (non-expert) counterpart!

In addition, there are achievements for beating the game in the hard and the expert modes. The same principle applies: if you win the expert-mode achievement without having won the other corresponding achievement, the latter is also immediately yours! Please know that beating this game in the expert mode means you are really special!

Have fun!

notes.title: Steam Overlay Issue on GNU/Linux Finally Resolved!
notes.notes:
Been interested in "Mutated Muter's Invasion", but holding on with your purchase decision because of the game not rendering the Steam Overlay on GNU/Linux (as it's been saying in the Early Access answers on the store page)? Wait no longer! From now, whether you are using Windows or GNU/Linux, the Steam Overlay will work in "Mutated Muter's Invasion" for you, so you can enjoy the same Steam experience independently of the OS.

As a reminder, the GNU/Linux version of "Mutated Muter's Invasion" will work on UPDATED Ubuntu 14.04 LTS (it is required that libstdc++6 be updated on 14.04 LTS) or a newer version of Ubuntu. Please also remember that the GNU/Linux version of the game is 64-bit.

As another reminder, "Mutated Muter's Invasion" works with OpenGL 3.x or higher. If you have OpenGL 2.x, the game [i]may[/i] render correctly, but this is not guaranteed.

notes.title: A Free Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
Want to learn more about "Mutated Muter's Invasion" before making a purchase decision? Perhaps get your hands on a free trial version to experience at least part of what the game has to offer? Now you finally can! While the free demo version offers only a limited portion of the game, it still provides a good opportunity to see beforehand what it feels like to play "Mutated Muter's Invasion".

The differences from the full version are:
[list]
[*]The demo version offers only [i]some[/i] levels to play; however, it still includes [i]both types[/i] of them (you will still have an opportunity to play a side-scroller shooting level from the game, not only platformer ones)
[*]The [i]levels[/i] themselves are [i]not exactly the same[/i] as in the full game, and this is the reason why there is no cloud-enabled progress saving between the demo and the full game (same for choosing the difficulty level); don't worry, however, the demo levels are still fun to play :)
[/list]

notes.title: Cloud-Enabled Saves Now Available!
notes.notes:
Dear un-Muters,

You can now choose to start a new game (thus overwriting progress data if any) or continue a previously saved game whenever you launch "Mutated Muter's Invasion" and get to the 'START' screen. Your progress is now saved whenever you complete a level. What's more, even if you choose 'NEW GAME', you will [b]not[/b] lose previously saved progress (if any) until you complete the first level, so you always get some time to change your mind! Choosing 'CONTINUE' lets you resume from the level that follows the last completed level, with all your collected items intact.
